evals.prompt: Add a local command group to osapi named greet, with one command, osapi greet get --name <name>, that prints a greeting for the name. A name is required.
evals.expected_output: internal/cli/commands/greet with a get method, its input and output types, a refusal for no name, its tests, and every check passing.
assertions: cli command validate passes
the group is registered under its name
its package tests pass with 100% coverage
every test in internal/cli/commands/all passes
at least one refusal is declared with Fails
generated files are current
lint reports no issues in the group
nothing outside the group, its registration, its wiring and generated files changed

evals.prompt: Add a local command group to osapi named checksum, with osapi checksum get --file <path>, that prints the SHA-256 of a file on this machine. The file system is a dependency, so a test can give it files.
evals.expected_output: internal/cli/commands/checksum with a get method that takes its file system from Deps, a test that gives it files, a refusal for no file, and every check passing.
assertions: cli command validate passes
the group is registered under its name
its package tests pass with 100% coverage
every test in internal/cli/commands/all passes
at least one refusal is declared with Fails
generated files are current
lint reports no issues in the group
nothing outside the group, its registration, its wiring and generated files changed
